summary: First backend testing iteration for Trade Intelligence Dashboard. All 11 pytest cases passed (100%) covering auth, seed (+idempotency), stats, grouped search, records CRUD, filters and Gemini 3 Flash image extraction via emergentintegrations.

minor.issue: country/buyer/exporter filters use anchored case-insensitive regex without escaping - values containing regex metacharacters (e.g. 'C&A Mode GmbH' - '&' is fine but '(', '+', '.' would break) could fail or match unexpectedly. Consider re.escape().
Tokens are stored in process memory (ACTIVE_TOKENS set). Any backend restart invalidates all logins. Acceptable for single-user MVP but worth noting.
Endpoint requires Bearer token but is idempotent; no way to re-seed without manual DB wipe. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~440 lines with inline 29-record SAMPLE_RECORDS constant; consider moving seed data to a separate data module for readability.
Regex filters in /api/records and /api/search do not escape user input - low risk (read-only, single user) but could cause 500s on special chars like '(' or '['.
ACTIVE_TOKENS is an in-memory set - tokens never expire and are lost on restart. For a long-lived single-user app, consider signed JWT or persisting hashed tokens.
/api/extract returns raw LLM text alongside parsed JSON; fine for debugging, but document this for frontend consumers.
All endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection. Good.
seed_data_creation: Seed endpoint populated 29 records on first call; verified idempotency on second call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified. 29 records seeded. Use password 'trade2026' to login. /api/extract works end-to-end with Gemini 3 Flash Preview via emergentintegrations - tested with a programmatically generated invoice PNG (PIL). Next iteration likely frontend-only.
